# attention.approve

Say yes. For a promote, the promote runs.

**Who may call:** the owner of its mission.

**Budget:** p95 150ms.

## Payload

| field | value |
|---|---|
| mission | attention.mission |
| attention | attention.id |

## Answer

(none)

## Move

`approve`: from open to approved, emitting AttentionApproved.

## Steps

- `attention.approve.record` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| AttentionNotOpen | 55 | AT-900 | the attention is in a state approve can't start from; carries `state` |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its mission; the handler never runs |

## How to call

```sh
work attention approve --mission <mission> --attention <attention>
```

HTTP: `POST /attention/approve` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.attention.approve(payload)`.

# question.list

List questions, oldest first, 50 to a page, filtered by mission, state.

**Who may call:** the owner of its mission.

**A read:** answered from the records, with no handler. A page of 50 at a time, oldest first, narrowed by mission, state; pass the answer's `next` as `cursor` for the page after it.

**Budget:** p95 80ms.

## Payload

| field | value |
|---|---|
| mission (optional) | question.mission |
| state (optional) | text |
| cursor (optional) | text |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| items | schema |
| next | schema |

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its mission; the handler never runs |

## How to call

```sh
work question list [--mission <mission>] [--state <state>] [--cursor <cursor>]
```

HTTP: `POST /question/list` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.question.list(payload)`.

# run

One agent working one task: which agent type, on which model, with what budget.

Lives in the database.

## Fields

| field | value |
|---|---|
| id | id |
| mission | mission.id |
| task | TaskKey |
| agent | AgentType |
| model | ModelName |
| budget | Cents |

## Machine

States: running, waiting, finished, failed, stopped. A move from the wrong state is refused RunNotRunning (exit 60).

| move | from | to | emits |
|---|---|---|---|
| start | (creates) | running | RunStarted |
| report | running, waiting | running, waiting | RunReported |
| finish | running | finished | RunFinished |
| fail | running, waiting | failed | RunFailed |
| stop | running, waiting | stopped | RunStopped |

## Operations

- [run.fail](fail.md): The run gave up, saying why.
- [run.finish](finish.md): The run pushed its branch. CI proves it; the run cannot close its own task.
- [run.list](list.md): List runs, newest first, 50 to a page, filtered by mission, task, state.
- [run.report](report.md): Say how the run is going. It moves no card.
- [run.start](start.md): Start an agent on one task. The run claims the task until it ends.
- [run.stop](stop.md): Stop the run. A person's act, or the mission stopping.

# run.start

Start an agent on one task. The run claims the task until it ends.

**Who may call:** the owner of its mission.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 250ms.

## Payload

| field | value |
|---|---|
| mission | run.mission |
| task | run.task |
| agent | run.agent |
| model | run.model |
| budget | run.budget |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| run | run.id |

## Move

`start`: from nothing (it creates) to running, emitting RunStarted.

## Steps

- `run.start.claim` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| RunOverBudget | 61 | RU-001 | declared in errors.ts, carrying left |
| RunAgentCannot | 62 | RU-002 | declared in errors.ts |
| RunTaskClaimed | 63 | RU-003 | declared in errors.ts |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its mission; the handler never runs |

## How to call

```sh
work run start --mission <mission> --task <task> --agent <agent> --model <model> --budget <budget>
```

HTTP: `POST /run/start` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.run.start(payload)`.
